steps.text: Open Time Crisis VR (Experimental) from Library > Unknown Sources. It unpacks its game files on the first start. On the boot screen, press A to insert credits, then the right trigger to start.

notes: The release APK bundles the game files and prepares them on the first start. The Quest asset was named -quest.apk up to v0.9.0 and -quest3.apk since v0.9.3, hence quest3?. Releases also carry a Windows build, a diagnostics zip in some versions, TC1-Quest-Upgrade.md and SHA256SUMS.
